gloss: to prophesy; to predict; to foretell

definitions.gloss: to prophesy; to predict; to foretell
definitions.explanation: To declare that something will happen in the future, whether based on supernatural insight, intuition, or conviction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予言|よげん}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{科学者|かがくしゃ}→科学者：19378_kagakusha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}→発生：03133_hassei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予言|よげん}した。
examples.english: A scientist predicted the occurrence of the earthquake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{書物|しょもつ}→書物：03683_shomotsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{混乱|こんらん}→混乱：02811_konran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予言|よげん}するような⟦{記述|きじゅつ}→記述：05819_kijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In old texts, there are passages that seem to prophesy the turmoil of this era.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{予言|よげん}→予言：20803_yogen⟧ (prophecy; prediction) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Carries a stronger, more dramatic nuance than simple prediction — often implies foresight, prophetic vision, or an uncanny ability to see the future. Frequently used in contexts involving religious prophecy, science fiction, and dramatic claims about the future.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{未来|みらい}→未来：03748_mirai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予言|よげん}する: to prophesy the future
- ⟦{予言|よげん}→予言：20803_yogen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧: a prophecy comes true
- ⟦{予言|よげん}→予言：20803_yogen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: a prophecy fails to come true
- {予言者|よげんしゃ}: prophet; seer
- ⟦{予言|よげん}→予言：20803_yogen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: book of prophecy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予測|よそく}する→予測する：19654_yosokusuru⟧: to predict; to forecast — more scientific and data-based, neutral in tone
- ⟦{予想|よそう}する→予想する：06064_yosousuru⟧: to expect; to anticipate — the most common everyday word for predicting outcomes
- {預言|よげん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to deliver a prophecy — same pronunciation but specifically religious prophecy (biblical context); ⟦{予言|よげん}→予言：20803_yogen⟧ is the general term
